name: Gumroad
notes: The 'I want this!' cart drawer needs the in-drawer checkout step; card entry is a standard Stripe Payment Element once reached.

steps.addToCart: Set the price (input[aria-label*=price]) for pay-what-you-want, click 'I want this!', then follow the /checkout link or the cart-drawer 'Checkout'.
steps.payment: Stripe Payment Element via waitStripeCardFrame. Card-number token, then the CVV token into the payment frame immediately after.
